blocks.title: TIFF to MMPK (ArcGIS Pro)
blocks.body:
# Procedure: Convert TIFF to MMPK (ArcGIS Pro)

Prepare BGSP / raster data in ArcGIS Pro and package it as a Mobile Map Package (MMPK) for offline use in MiliNav.

## Overview

| Requirement | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Tool | ArcGIS Pro |
| Input | BGSP / TIFF raster data |
| Output | Mobile Map Package (`.mmpk`) |
| Coordinate system | **WGS84 only** (ArcGIS SDK reads WGS84; MiliNav converts in-app) |

## Workflow

```text
BGSP / TIFF  →  Add to map (WGS84)
             →  Mosaic to New Raster
             →  Copy Raster (remove black area)
             →  Share → Mobile Map → Package (.mmpk)
```

## 1. Add BGSP data to the map

1. Add your BGSP / TIFF data to the ArcGIS Pro map.
2. Confirm the data is in the **WGS84** coordinate system.

![Add data and verify WGS84](/media/tiff-to-mmpk/page-02.jpg)

## 2. Mosaic the raster

1. Open **Toolboxes → Raster → Raster Dataset → Mosaic to New Raster**.
2. Fill the **Geoprocessing** parameters to match the expected mosaic settings.
3. Click **Run**.

## 3. Remove black areas (Copy Raster)

1. Open **Toolboxes → Raster → Raster Dataset → Copy Raster**.
2. Fill the Geoprocessing parameters as shown in the procedure.
3. Click **Run** to produce a cleaned raster without black borders.

![Copy Raster / remove black area](/media/tiff-to-mmpk/page-03.jpg)

## 4. Package as Mobile Map (MMPK)

1. On the taskbar, click **Share → Mobile Map**.
2. Fill the **Package Mobile Map** settings.
3. Click **Package** to generate the `.mmpk` file for MiliNav.

![Share Mobile Map packaging](/media/tiff-to-mmpk/page-04.jpg)

## Tips

- Keep only WGS84 rasters in the package to avoid load failures on device.
- After packaging, copy the MMPK into the device map storage path used by MiliNav (see Storage Paths & Decryption).
- For encrypted offline maps, follow the Technical Guide encryption / SD card deployment steps after packaging.
